search_units.name: search_units

parameters.description: A formation, group or member name, such as Mancos or Green River. Macrostrat matches it loosely, so 'Mancos' finds the Mancos Shale and its members.
parameters.name: strat_name

parameters.description: Only those of this geologic time interval, such as the Permian or the Tremadocian. Pick one from the international time scale, or type any other interval's name or ID.
parameters.name: interval

parameters.description: Only rocks of this age, in millions of years ago (Ma), such as 271. Use this or an age range, not both.
parameters.name: age_ma

parameters.description: With 'Oldest age (Ma)', only rocks that formed at some time between the two ages. Ages count back from today, so this is the smaller number. Leave it empty for up to today.
parameters.name: youngest_age_ma

parameters.description: The older end of the age range, in millions of years ago, such as 260. Leave it empty for back to the Earth's beginning.
parameters.name: oldest_age_ma

parameters.description: Only these rocks: a whole class (all igneous rocks), a type (all carbonate rocks) or one lithology, such as sandstone. A lithology's name can be typed too.
parameters.name: lithology

parameters.description: Only rocks that formed in this environment: a class (marine or non-marine), a type (such as fluvial) or one environment, such as deltaic. An environment's name can be typed too.
parameters.name: environment

parameters.description: Only rocks with this economic use or resource: a class (energy, material, precious commodity or water), a type (such as hydrocarbon) or one use, such as coal or aquifer.
parameters.name: economic_use

parameters.description: To search at a place: its latitude in decimal degrees, from -90 to 90, with 'Longitude'.
parameters.name: latitude

parameters.description: To search at a place: its longitude in decimal degrees, from -180 to 180, with 'Latitude'.
parameters.name: longitude

parameters.description: Also include the columns that touch the one at the place (or the 'Column' given), for a wider look at the region.
parameters.name: include_adjacent

parameters.description: Only those of this column, by its ID from 'Find stratigraphic columns'. On its own, lists a column's rock units top down.
parameters.name: column

parameters.description: Only columns of this Macrostrat project: a region such as North America or New Zealand, or the offshore drilling sites.
parameters.name: project

parameters.description: Youngest first (the top of a column down), or oldest first.
parameters.name: order

options.label: Youngest first (top of the column down)

parameters.description: How many to return, from 1 to 100.
parameters.name: limit

parameters.description: Which page of results to return, from 1.
parameters.name: page

attribution.description: The credit Macrostrat's CC BY 4.0 licence asks for, ready to show wherever the data is published, alongside the source citations given with the results.

count.description: How many are in this answer.

more_available.description: True when there is a next page.

references.description: The publications the results cite, by the reference ID each result names.

citation.description: The reference as one citation line.

units.description: The rock units, in the order chosen.

age.description: The age as words and numbers, oldest first, such as 'Paibian to Tremadocian, 497 to 477.1 Ma' (Ma: millions of years ago).

color.description: The color Macrostrat draws it in, as a hex code.

column_id.description: The column it is in. 'Get a column' takes it.

economic_uses.description: What the rock is used for or holds, such as an aquifer, coal or oil.

class.description: Its class: energy, material, precious commodity or water.

econ_id.description: The economic use's ID. The 'Economic use' fields take it.

name.description: The economic use, such as 'aquifer' or 'coal'.

proportion.description: Its share, from 0 to 1, where Macrostrat gives one.

environments.description: The environments the rock formed in, the largest share first.

environ_id.description: The environment's ID. The 'Environment' fields take it.

name.description: The environment, such as 'inferred marine' or 'deltaic'.

proportion.description: Its share, from 0 to 1, where Macrostrat gives one.

formation.description: The formation it is, or is in.

fossil_collections.description: How many Paleobiology Database fossil collections come from it.

fossil_occurrences.description: How many fossil occurrences those hold.

latitude.description: The latitude of its column's centre.

lithologies.description: Each rock type in it, the largest share first.

attributes.description: How it is described, such as 'fine' or 'cross-bedded'.

class.description: Its class: sedimentary, igneous or metamorphic.

lith_id.description: The rock type's ID. The 'Rock type' fields take it.

name.description: The rock type, such as 'dolomite' or 'sandstone'.

proportion.description: Its share of the rock, from 0 to 1, where Macrostrat gives one.

lithology.description: Its rock types as text, with their shares, such as 'dolomite 83%, quartz arenite 17%'.

longitude.description: The longitude of its column's centre.

measurement_types.description: The kinds of measurement held for it, such as 'geochemical minor elements'. 'List measurements' lists them.

member.description: The member it is, or is in.

min_thickness_m.description: Its least thickness, in metres (0 can mean not known).

name.description: The unit's name, such as 'Mancos Shale Fm'.

oldest_age_ma.description: When it begins: its oldest age, in millions of years ago (Ma).

oldest_interval.description: The time interval its oldest age falls in, such as 'Paibian'.

paleo_latitude_bottom.description: Where its column was when the unit's bottom formed: the latitude then.

paleo_latitude_top.description: Where its column was when the unit's top formed: the latitude then.

project_id.description: The project its column belongs to.

reference_ids.description: The references the unit is compiled from.

section_id.description: The section (package) of the column it is in.

strat_name.description: Its full stratigraphic name, such as 'Mancos Shale'.

strat_name_id.description: Its stratigraphic name's ID. 'Get a stratigraphic name' takes it.

unit_id.description: The rock unit's ID. 'Get a rock unit' takes it.

units_above.description: The units resting on top of it.

youngest_age_ma.description: When it ends: its youngest age, in millions of years ago (Ma).

youngest_interval.description: The time interval its youngest age falls in, such as 'Tremadocian'.

description: Look up the geology of any place with Macrostrat, the open geology database from the University of Wisconsin-Madison: what rock is under a point, with its age, rock types and the map it comes from; geologic map units and maps; stratigraphic columns and their rock units; the fossil collections and measurements matched to them; stratigraphic names; the geologic time scale; and minerals. Every result carries its source citation. No account or API key required.
